text:
Alex: Quick sync — recommendation: trim Payments v1 scope. Ship a slim checkout for MVP in June, push full PCI + scheduled invoicing to v2.

Maria: Which features are non-negotiable for pilot customers? Two signals asking for scheduled invoices + CSV exports.

Alex: For MVP we keep: one-time checkout API, hosted invoice link, refund endpoint, tokenized card storage. Defer: scheduled invoices, invoice scheduling UI, advanced CSV exports. That should shave ~5 dev-weeks overall.

Raj: Engineering note: scheduled invoices touches the billing pipeline, retry semantics, and idempotency. CSV export itself is fast but needs retention + permission checks. Cutting scheduled avoids a schema migration and extra worker processes.

Tomas: Infra: scheduled jobs require a Dedicated queue and monitoring pages. Also DB indices for schedule rows. If we defer, we avoid extra on-call burden during launch.

Eve: Need explicit launch criteria so PM/ops know when to call it done. Proposing acceptance checklist:
```
- Checkout API implemented & load-tested (target 250 RPS)
- Hosted invoice link + refund flow end-to-end
- Idempotency E2E tests for one-time payments
- Security review passed for stored tokens
- Rollout flag and canary playbook documented
```
Also create a v2 ticket with clear acceptance tests for scheduled invoicing.

Maria: Customer impact: two pilots will lose scheduled invoicing. I can offer a short-term workaround (manual CSV + customer-run scheduler). They'll accept if we commit to a v2 timeframe. I'll get signoff and confirm by EOD Friday.

Raj: Plan for rollout: add a feature flag -> canary 10% traffic -> 50% after 24h if error rate < 0.1% and latency SLO met -> 100%. Add monitoring on payment failures, double-charges, and refunds.

Alex: Rollback triggers: >0.1% payment error OR evidence of duplicate charges. Rollback steps in doc.

Tomas: Ops checklist for rollback: disable scheduler enqueue, switch invoice reads to replica, revoke/rotate API keys if tokens compromised, and run the quick-consistency job.

Eve: I'll update the PRD/milestone tracker and link the canary playbook. Maria, ping me once customers sign.

Maria: On it, will loop in legal + two pilot contacts.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: payments-checkout-service v1.2.0 -> staging :rocket:

Alex: Thanks all — I'll fold this into the milestone reset note and flag for exec review tomorrow. :thumbsup:
